title: Very cheap looking
text: Very cheap looking. This clock is not wooden...it is paper pasted over particle board, very flimsy and cheap.  The design is nice, but overall, very disappointing.  Hung it in my kitchen, but considering sending it back after looking at it for two days.  Not impressed at all.
